children: FRANKFURT--The German Finance Agency left its debt issuance target for the fourth quarter unchanged from the preliminary plans it published in December last year, it said Thursday.

In the preliminary funding target for 2026, the Finance Agency penciled in 59 billion euros ($67.17 billion) in government bond issuance at auctions, excluding green bonds. The agency plans to conduct one green bond auction in the fourth quarter.
The Finance Agency also penciled in 47 billion euros for the issuance of treasury bills, known as Bubills, for the October-December quarter.
